projects.name: Plate position and compound response in a viability assay
projects.description: Does compound MX-12 reduce viability in HEK293 cells, or does the apparent dose response track where the wells sit on the plate?

experiments.title: MX-12 dose response, first pass
experiments.question: Does MX-12 reduce viability at 10 uM, or is the apparent effect positional?
experiments.context_json: {"cell line": "HEK293", "passage": "p14", "plate": "96-well, clear bottom", "compound": "MX-12, 8-point series, 0.1 to 10 uM", "incubation": "48 h", "layout": "doses in columns, vehicle control in column 1", "readout": "CellTiter-Glo luminescence; n = 3 wells per dose"}

experiments.title: Run 1, plate uniformity check
experiments.question: Does the assay give a uniform vehicle signal across the plate?
experiments.context_json: {"cell line": "HEK293", "passage": "p12", "plate": "96-well, clear bottom", "compound": "vehicle only", "incubation": "48 h", "readout": "CellTiter-Glo luminescence; all 96 wells"}

experiments.title: Run 2, first dose response
experiments.question: Does MX-12 reduce viability, and at what concentration?
experiments.context_json: {"cell line": "HEK293", "passage": "p14", "plate": "96-well, clear bottom", "compound": "MX-12, 8-point series, 0.1 to 10 uM", "incubation": "48 h", "layout": "doses in columns, ascending left to right", "readout": "CellTiter-Glo luminescence; n = 3 wells per dose"}

experiments.title: Run 3, randomised layout
experiments.question: With dose position randomised, does the potency estimate survive?
experiments.context_json: {"cell line": "HEK293", "passage": "p16", "plate": "96-well, clear bottom", "compound": "MX-12, 8-point series, 0.1 to 10 uM", "incubation": "48 h", "layout": "doses randomised across the plate, outer columns filled with buffer", "readout": "CellTiter-Glo luminescence; n = 4 wells per dose"}

experiments.title: Run 4, fresh compound stock
experiments.question: Does the residual effect survive a fresh MX-12 stock?
experiments.context_json: {"cell line": "HEK293", "passage": "p18", "plate": "96-well, clear bottom", "compound": "MX-12, fresh stock, lot B, 8-point series, 0.1 to 10 uM", "incubation": "48 h", "layout": "doses randomised across the plate, outer columns filled with buffer", "readout": "CellTiter-Glo luminescence; n = 4 wells per dose"}

notes.body: Outer wells looked to have less medium at 48 h, a visible meniscus difference against the inner columns.
Plate sat closest to the incubator door and the door was opened several times during the run.
Column 12 read brighter across every dose, including the vehicle wells.
Plate ran on the lower shelf, near the incubator door.
Outer columns looked to have slightly less medium at the endpoint.
Same shelf position as run 1.
Highest doses sat in the rightmost columns, at the plate edge.
Outer columns again looked low on medium at the endpoint.
Outer columns filled with buffer this time, not cells.
Same MX-12 stock as run 2.
Plate on the lower shelf again.
New MX-12 stock, prepared the same morning.
Randomised layout again, same as run 3.
Plate sat mid-shelf this time, not by the door.
d0: seed HEK293 at 5,000 cells per well in 100 uL, 96-well clear-bottom plate
d0: allow 4 h to attach before dosing
d0: dose MX-12 as an 8-point series, 0.1 to 10 uM, vehicle control in column 1
d1: visual check for evaporation in the outer columns
d2: 48 h endpoint, equilibrate the plate to room temperature for 30 min
d2: CellTiter-Glo, 10 min orbital shake, read luminescence

commitments.expected: Vehicle signal should be flat across all columns.
commitments.observed: Vehicle signal approx 12 percent lower in the outer columns, 1 and 12.
commitments.interpretation: The assay works, with a mild edge effect I can handle by excluding the outer columns.
commitments.disconfirming: If the gap persists after excluding the outer columns, it is not position.

commitments.expected: A dose-dependent drop in signal if MX-12 is active.
commitments.observed: Clear dose response, apparent IC50 near 2 uM. Strongest apparent killing in the highest-dose columns, which sat at the plate edge.
commitments.interpretation: MX-12 reduces viability with an IC50 around 2 uM.
commitments.disconfirming: If randomising dose position across the plate moves the IC50, the effect is positional.

commitments.expected: If the run 2 potency was purely positional, the dose response should flatten.
commitments.observed: IC50 approx 6 uM. Effect smaller than run 2 but still present.
commitments.interpretation: Most of the original potency was plate position, but a real effect remains.
commitments.disconfirming: If a fresh compound stock removes the residual effect, it was the stock and not the compound.

resolutions.notes: Excluding the outer columns flattened vehicle signal to within 3 percent.
Randomising the layout shifted the IC50 to about 6 uM.

glossary.plain: A luminescent assay that estimates viable cell number from ATP content.
Systematic differences in the outer wells of a microplate, usually caused by uneven evaporation.
Wells given the solvent alone, with no compound, used as the comparison baseline.
The concentration at which a response falls to half of its maximum.
The number of times a cell culture has been detached and reseeded into new vessels.
